what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Barbados in all host countries: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 722 Barbadian asylum seekers, and Canada hosted 97.6% of them.
After Canada, the largest hosts are the United Kingdom and the United States.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Barbados, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2024 and 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 8 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
